# fixture handoff

- Never hand-edit the cursor block. Note the gate requires the literal
  `<!-- spine:cursor -->` fence on its own line — a hand-written one will not do.
- The grammar reference, shown as an indented example so it stays prose:

      effort: <kebab-name>
      prd: docs/specs/<file>.md
